population.original_GPS_barometric_individual_ident: original run 39716885648 (27 birds, each native sensor Holm p=.002; NOT clean alias-exclusion sensitivity)
population.prior_ERA5_SOURCE_gate_run: 39723205971 (JSON source stage completed; audit key-name mismatch followed calculation)
population.tag_conflict: Test geodesy instrument ID and both birds under same tag local identifier 182208 excluded without examining heights
population.earlier_frozen_CERRA_contrast: CERRA 2021 Jul-Dec entire 184 days missing; original gate remains unavailable, ERA5 is a newly versioned coarser climate source.

current_source.climate: Open-Meteo ECMWF ERA5 100m wind_speed_100m m/s, site-sampled, native ERA5 coarse grid (44.25N,3.25E)
current_source.exposure_groups: Within YYYY-MM all-calendar daily 24h wind mean Q25/Q75, low/high/middle
current_source.climate_causal_warning: Only site-level weather, independent of heights but not actual uplift at GPS flight location.
current_source.track_source: Original 9 seasons, 5min earliest nonheight eligible GPS speed 5-55m/s and source QA; same 5km EPSG6933 cells. No source change after outcome.

test.B_species_shared_context: For focal bird i, the common source population response to wind in same 5km cell + calendar YYYY-MM, estimated from ≥2 other birds each with >=10 low and >=10 high donor events, each bird equal with its own days equal; REMOVE full same UTC date and focal bird from other birds.
test.A_individual_own_context: For same focal bird i, same cell and wind regime train from own other dates, donor day equally weighted (Jeffreys 0.5 bin pseudocount).
test.contrast: Matched held-out target GPS events log P_A/P_B, each target day equal, low/high regime equal per bird, birds equal.
test.donor_support: Require original source gate ≥10 own same-state other-day and ≥10 own opposite-state other-day fixes at cell, and same 5km cell/year-month ≥2 other birds each with both wind-state donor fixes >=10 excluding target UTC date; measured again on joint GPS/baro-valid events.
test.companion_sensor: bar:barometric-height paired same source fixes; not an independent sample/sensor unless independent calibration verified.
test.source_population_selection: Limit biological TARGETS to 25 source-preheight ERA5 eligible bird IDs. Retain all 27 tag-clean native birds as OTHER-bird donor distribution, but never score donors as target if outside frozen 25.
test.randomization: 999 shared-whole-CALENDAR-day wind state exchanges within each YYYY-MM across all 2019-21 calendar days, SYNCHRONIZED for all birds (never permute regional wind separately bird-by-bird). Recompute model source and n birds per exchange.
test.sensor_multiplicity: Holm across two paired sensor comparisons; include unavailable as p=1, and require positive observed minus null baseline for any exploratory support.
test.no_rescue: If n<10 or null<950, declare unavailable. Do not change calendar bins, source weather provider, location, source cohorts, tag quarantine, 5km cells, GPS/barometric joint quality or min donor days.

interpretation: Exploratory ecological case study because this exact native source's altitude identity is already in earlier frozen results. A positive individual-vs-shared wind prediction cannot imply a genetic or adaptive flight rule. Negative or unsupported is not proof all birds have identical environmental response.
source_overlap: Previous positive Gyps fulvus Scacco source parents are Bardenas Reales and Scavengers and wild ungulates; France Grands Causses has distinct source study names and zero exact animal-ID overlaps, physical device aliases still uncertain.
